q: The pressure of a gas in a cylinder stays at 200 kPa while its volume grows by 0.50 litres. How much work does the gas do while the piston moves?
The energy of fuel is supplied to a car engine at a power of $60\,\text{kW}$, and the efficiency of the engine is $30\,\%$. What is the mechanical power, and where does the rest of the energy go?
a: The mechanical power is 0.30 · $60\,\text{kW}$ = $18\,\text{kW}$. The remaining $42\,\text{kW}$ is transferred as heat to the surroundings through the exhaust gases and the radiator.
